relevance_note: The paper reports a family in which the proband and his father carry a heterozygous TNFAIP3 deletion: "拷贝数变异分析发现先证者及其父亲存在TNFAIP3外显子2~9杂合缺失".
method_note: Read the full Markdown manually; no table transcription (the paper has no tables in the Markdown; supplementary table 附表1 listing the 19 published CNV-HA20 patients is NOT in the Markdown, so those patients could not be extracted individually). Rows were built with a Python script from values chosen by hand, and every span was checked verbatim against the paper by script. Individuals: Ⅲ-4 (proband) and Ⅱ-4 (father) are first-hand. '先证者母亲' is a constructed label: the paper refers to her only within '先证者及其父母'/'患儿及其父母' (WES/CNV-tested; the deletion was reported only in the proband and father); no clinical data, so all checklist items are not reported. The sentence '家系中其他成员无发热、腹泻、腹痛、口腔溃疡、关节炎等临床表现，但未进行基因检测' concerns unnamed, untested relatives; no rows were created and, under D-21, it excludes nothing for anyone (it does not name the mother, who was tested). Literature individuals from the Discussion are separate rows with source_reference_in_review: the patient of 尹美娜等［6］ (stated to carry the same deletion as this family; the variant row uses the family's variant string with a second span stating identity), the 3-year-old girl of Zhang等［9］ and her asymptomatic carrier mother, the adult-onset patient of 文献［7］ (only onset and CNV-HA20 membership given; no variant row because no specific variant is printed), and the younger and older brothers of a Japanese survey family ［20］ (no variant printed; no variant rows). Ages: Ⅲ-4's '3岁4个月' is his age at admission on 2024-01-11; follow-up then continued 1.5 years and no later age is printed. Ⅱ-4's onset '33岁' comes from the Discussion (case text says '3年前' at age 36). n_patients_reported=2 is counted from the stated diagnosis of the proband and his father (not a printed number); the Discussion's 19-patient literature count includes this family. first_author is not reported because the Markdown has no author line. Inheritance: proband 'inherited paternal' because the father carries the same deletion and both parents were tested; Zhang girl 'inherited maternal' because '患儿母亲携带相同变异' (father's status not stated). Father's laboratory values (ESR 28 mm/1 h, CRP 9.67 mg/L, WBC 7.64, fecal calprotectin 176 μg/g) are printed without normal ranges or interpretation for him, so no abnormal/normal rows were emitted and his inflammatory-marker checklist item is not reported. Proband's oral ulcers: recurrent oral ulcers from age 3 (and in the diagnosis summary) vs '口腔黏膜未见溃疡' at the admission exam; treated as a point-in-time finding, not a contradiction, so both rows are emitted and the checklist stays observed. Likewise the post-treatment follow-up colonoscopy '未见溃疡' is emitted as excluded but the GI checklist item stays observed. Narrow absences not used for checklist exclusion: '无皮疹、瘀点、瘀斑' (skin lesions composite), '全身浅表淋巴结不大' (lymphoproliferation/lymphadenopathy; abdominal hypoechoic nodules also reported), normal liver function (autoimmune hepatitis). Anaemia (Hb 90 g/L) is not stated to be autoimmune, so cytopenia (autoimmune) is not reported. Perianal ulcers were not mapped to genital ulcers. Yin patient: 'fever' without 'recurrent', so the recurrent-fever checklist item is not reported; perianal ulcer/abdominal pain/diarrhoea not mapped to GI ulcers or inflammation. Older brother's '严重神经系统症状' not mapped to CNS involvement (CNS not specified). Zhang mother's '无临床症状' recorded as one excluded feature; checklist left not reported because no specific feature is named. Autoantibodies excluded for the proband from explicit negative ANA, ANCA, RF, anti-CCP and autoimmune antibody panel. Internal discrepancy noted: Ⅱ-4 gastroscopy says '慢性非萎缩性胃炎' whereas gastric pathology says '轻度慢性萎缩性胃炎'; both recorded. Zhang等［9］ is cited among the CNV references ［6-19］, yet the girl described from it carries a nonsense c.1300_1301delinsTA variant; recorded as printed. functional_evidence_statement for the family deletion records the qPCR validation (results only in Figure 3); no functional assay of A20 or NF-κB is reported. Composite '肝脾淋巴结肿大' was split into three rows (liver, spleen, lymph nodes) sharing the same feature text.
